auto_register_in_illegal_mode.label: Go to the tower when registration opens
auto_register_in_illegal_mode.tooltip:
When Forked Tower registration opens, BOCCHI stops what it is doing, goes to the entry pad and waits there until you are teleported in. Illegal Mode switches off once you are inside.
North Horn: skipped below Knowledge Level 40.
South Horn: you still have to offer your Sanguine Ciphers yourself. BOCCHI reminds you.
